customManagers.description: The Testcontainers image is a string literal, so no built-in manager sees it. Without this it silently drifts from the Postgres in docker-compose.

packageRules.description: Every dependency bump is a chore. Nothing here reads commit types for releases, and the `fix(deps)` that `config:recommended` applies to production dependencies would claim a bug was fixed.
Add `docker` label for container image updates, wherever they are declared — matching the datasource also covers the Testcontainers image above.
Add `github_actions` label for GitHub Actions related updates.
Group all minor and patch updates together for GitHub Actions.
Group all minor and patch npm updates together.
Monthly lockfile refresh carries no version bump of its own.
Keep Node.js at major version only across .nvmrc and the Dockerfile.
Group every Node.js runtime version bump (.nvmrc, Dockerfile) into one PR.
@types/node majors track Node majors, so anything above the .nvmrc line types APIs the runtime does not have. Raise this bound in the same change that raises .nvmrc.
Postgres runs in both compose files and in the Testcontainers suite; a split bump means tests pass against a version production is not running.
The React type definitions live in DefinitelyTyped, so `group:monorepos` does not pull them in with react and react-dom. Split majors type-check against the wrong React.
